title: 30A Ocean Pearl
meta_description: Welcome to Ocean Pearl 30A by AvantStay! New coastal-chic 4BR with bikes, screened patios \& walkable beach access in laid-back Dune Allen.
description_expanded:
\*Please note that this home is also available for 28+ night stays.\*

ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Ocean Pearl 30A. This newly constructed home is coastal chic and designed with family comfort and enjoyment in mind. With its open concept living, dining and kitchen areas, three master suites and lots of kid friendly spaces, there's plenty of room for everyone to spread out and enjoy their time at the beach. The home is situated in an upscale neighborhood right on 30A and walkable to the beach. The fireplace in the living room creates a cozy feeling and helps warm you up on those cool evenings, watching a movie or your favorite team. Ocean Pearl 30A comes with 2 complimentary bikes and a 6-seater golf cart, making it easy to explore the nearby communities, the beach, and Scenic 30A. After a fun day in the sun, enjoy your evening cocktail on one of the three screened-in patios or balconies that overlook the wooded nature preserve.

\*\*\*New Construction

ABOUT THE AREA: Dune Allen can be described as laid-back old Florida. With miles of trails, five coastal dune lakes and sprawling beaches, it's a nature lovers dream. It's perfect for families who don't like the crowds and restrictions of other 30A beaches yet close to restaurants, shops, and entertainment.

BEACH ACCESS: Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is at the end of Woodward Drive and right across from Stinky's Fish Camp Restaurant. (5999 W Co Hwy 30-A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459). This beach has restrooms, parking, a lifeguard station, and is ADA accessible. A little further to the East on 30A is Fort Panic Regional Access. This beach is also ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguard. No Need to determine what area of the beach is assessable. Both Public Beach Accesses have plenty of space to enjoy your days on the beach.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King bed with ensuite bathroom and access to balcony (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King bed with ensuite bathroom and access to balcony (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- King bed with ensuite bathroom and access to balcony (3rd Floor)
• Bedroom 4 -- Twin XL Bunk Beds, Full Bed \& Gaming Area below (3rd Floor)
• Nook 1 -- Twin XL Bunk Beds in Loft (2nd Floor)
• Nook 2 -- Twin Bed in Loft (3rd Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Public Beach Access
• Access to neighborhood pool (no bands or key required)
• 11 Smart TV's throughout
• 2 Bikes (complimentary)
• 6-seater Golf Cart
• Gas Fireplace
• Weber Grill
• 6 porches (3 screened in) with outdoor dining and seating
• 2 Porch Swings (one daybed swing)
• Glam Station with light up make-up mirror
• Office Workspace area -- 2nd Floor
• Outdoor shower
• 3 master suites
• Mini kitchenette with coffee bar, mini refrigerator, and microwave
• Full size laundry room
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for 3 vehicles.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
